info.name: SIDIS – Modo B (Docker)
info.description:
AISafe distributed system, Mode B: Docker stack (docker compose -f infrastructure/docker-compose.secure.yml up --build). Single entry through the gateways https://localhost:8443 and https://localhost:8444; 2 replicas per service; services expose no ports; ACCEPT_DEV_TOKENS=false.

Use with the SIDIS environment (only gateway, gateway2, realm, clientId, pwd* and apiKey matter). Turn off 'SSL certificate verification' in Postman (or use newman --insecure).
Role of each request: tag {ADMIN} {ATCC} {BACKOFFICE} {TECH} {SUPERVISOR} {NONE} in the name (default ATCC). The expected status is also in the name ('→ 200').
Folders 00 to 07: automatic (Collection Runner / Newman with 100 ms delay). Folder 09: manual; run the docker command between [ ] before sending each request (service names: docker compose ps).

item.description: Run request by request, in order. Before sending each request, run the command between [ ] in the infrastructure folder (docker compose -f docker-compose.secure.yml ...). Before starting: run folders 00 and 04 (tokens are valid for 5 minutes and base data is created). Exact service names: docker compose ps.

exec: const name = pm.info.requestName, env = k => pm.environment.get(k);
const base = Date.UTC(2031 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 8), Math.floor(Math.random() * 12), 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 25));
const K = {ADMIN: 'Admin', ATCC: 'Atcc', BACKOFFICE: 'Backoffice', TECH: 'Tech', SUPERVISOR: 'Supervisor'}[role];
const U = {ADMIN: 'admin.user', ATCC: 'atcc.user', BACKOFFICE: 'backoffice.user', TECH: 'tech.user', SUPERVISOR: 'supervisor.user'}[role];
const setH = t => pm.request.headers.upsert({key: 'Authorization', value: 'Bearer ' + t});
if (env('token' + K) && Number(env('exp' + K) || 0) > Date.now() + 15000) { setH(env('token' + K)); return; }

const login = (b, cb) => pm.sendRequest({url: b + '/realms/' + env('realm') + '/protocol/openid-connect/token', method: 'POST', header: {'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'}, body: {mode: 'urlencoded', urlencoded: [{key: 'grant_type', value: 'password'}, {key: 'client_id', value: env('clientId')}, {key: 'username', value: U}, {key: 'password', value: env('pwd' + K)}]}}, cb);

const ok = (e, r) => { if (e || r.code !== 200) return false; const j = r.json(); pm.environment.set('token' + K, j.access_token); pm.environment.set('exp' + K, String(Date.now() + j.expires_in * 1000)); setH(j.access_token); return true; };
login(env('gateway'), (e, r) => { if (!ok(e, r)) login(env('gateway2'), (e2, r2) => { if (!ok(e2, r2)) console.error('Login failed for role ' + role); }); });
